footprint_target_cm.source: BP_PickupXP PickupMesh /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube (100 cm) x scale 0.3; big block scale 1.8 (root 0.54) applied in game, not baked

warnings: M_XPChipBig_core_bright and _dark are emissive in Blender (strength 4, #FF26BF and #B0107F): the FBX does not carry emission, the Unreal material sets the glow (MI_PickupXPBig)

C1.evidence: run 4: unchanged, same geometry and colours as run 3. (run 3: same as run 2, untouched: slab 30 x 30 x 3.4 cm (11 %), four tiles. Differs: source seams thinner and flush.)

C2.evidence: Proportions, chamfer, notches unchanged; the 0.3 cm band on the chamfer top edge is now #8F959F, same grey as legs, no longer brighter. Differs: notches small, chamfer a little lighter than source.

C3.evidence: run 4: unchanged, same geometry and colours as run 3. (run 3: Gem 11.8 cm wide (39 %), stepped faceted (slope, vertical step, slope, flat top), top 2.7 cm above the rim (rim at 7.9, top 10.6); opening 0.9 cm deep; slope facets alternate #FF26BF and #B0107F by orientation with flat shading, so 3 tones are visible in the render (bright, dark, mid). Differs: the source gem is flatter and sits flush in its opening; ours stands taller by design (owner request).)

C4.evidence: run 4: unchanged, same geometry and colours as run 3. (run 3: same as run 2, untouched: 6 identical legs, rounded elbow, flat feet. Differs: source legs chunkier.)

C5.evidence: run 4: unchanged, same geometry and colours as run 3. (run 3: same as run 2, untouched: 4 regular hex bolts. Differs: source heads have a small top chamfer.)

C6.evidence: run 4: unchanged, same geometry and colours as run 3. (run 3: same as run 2, untouched: 5 traces, 3 components. Differs: source traces use 45 degree bends.)

C7.evidence: Gunmetal board and casing, lighter gunmetal chamfer, legs, bolts, traces and bands light grey (#8A9099 to #8F959F), core magenta, no cyan.

C8.evidence: 872 tris (max 1000), 30 x 30 x 10.6 cm, pivot bottom centre, flat shading, UV checks pass.

C9.evidence: run 4: unchanged, same geometry and colours as run 3. (run 3: Without the source the core reads as a raised faceted crystal standing proud of a sloped casing: its lower facets are fully visible down to the opening floor, no recess wall hides any part, light and dark facets give volume, it does not read as a flat pink square. Differs: the gem is taller and its base sits close to the light rim.)

C10.evidence: Opening inner wall (0.9 cm) and floor around the gem base are now edge_band by recolouring; tris 872, unchanged. In the close crop (ortho 16) a continuous light grey ring runs from the gem base to the rim and the chamfer band, no dark gunmetal visible between gem and rim. edge_band #8F959F, in the legs range (#8A9099 to #959CA6); the chamfer top band uses it too. Differs: the flat rim strip is kept as the C2 thin flat rim, now merged visually with the opening.
